text: Improved Hunter's Mark is a Hunter talent in the Marksmanship tree. It increases the ranged attack power bonus of Hunter's Mark and decreases its mana cost.

Improved Mark of the Wild is a talent in the first tier of the Druid Restoration tree. In addition to greatly increasing the effect of the Mark of the Wild and Gift of the Wild spells, it also increases the druid's total strength, agility, stamina, intellect, and spirit by 1%/2%. Note that while the bonus to Mark of the Wild applies to everyone affected by the druid's Mark of the Wild, the passive increase to attributes only applies to the druid herself.
Improved Cower is a pet talent located in the 2nd tier of the Ferocity Tree.

Improved Insect Swarm is a tier 5 talent in the Balance tree. You will need Insect Swarm to access it, and you will need to spend 24 points in Balance to max it. Improved Insect Swarm increases your Starfire critical strike chance by a maximum of 3% when Moonfire is on the target and increases your Wrath damage by 3% maximum when Insect Swarm is on the target.
Improved Shields is a Shaman talent in the Enhancement tree. It increases the effect of the Earth Shield, Lightning Shield, and Water Shield abilities by up to 15%.

Improved Spirit Tap is a talent in the Shadow tree, you will need to spend 5 points in Shadow to max it. It increases total spirit and mana regeneration on a Mind Blast/Shadow Word: Death critical strike.
Improved Fear is a passive specialization ability for Affliction warlocks, available at level 69. It induces the target of the Warlock's fear into a nightmare, which slows their speed.
Improved Serpent Sting is a passive specialization ability for Survival hunters, available at level 70.

Improved Mana Gem is an Arcane mage talent that allows the gain of Spell power equal to 2% of your current maximum mana after consuming a Mana Gem. This talent works great in conjunction with the Arcane mastery Mana Adept.
Improved Judgment would have been a passive paladin ability, available at level 28.
Improved Frenzied Regeneration was a druid Draenor Perk, available as early as level 91, though it was not guaranteed to be acquired until level 99.

Impure Elementium Ore is looted from Elementium Slats. It also drops from the following mobs in Highmountain: *Uzgarogg the Seer *Gazarogg the Stonespeaker *Twilight Shardkeeper *Twilight Orelifter *Bound Elemental
Impulsor is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Improved Healing Surge is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Improvised Flight System has the same function as the "Skyterror" Personal Delivery System.

Incineratus is a fire fury located at the Throne of the Elements in Nagrand. He's currently not involved in any quests. Though, he is said to have created the Living Fire, and Salandria is advised not to get too close to him. If you attacked somebody around him, he would one shot you. Shortly before the Cataclysm, Thrall journeyed to Garadar to discover why the elements of Azeroth were so afraid. During this event, Thrall would communicate with Incineratus to see if the fury could enlighten him to what was causing the elements their fear. In response, Incineratus blessed Thrall with some of his power to aid him in his quest.
Indestructible Potion is crafted with Alchemy (400); taught by trainers.
__NOTOC__ An Indestructible Alchemist Stone is an improved version of the Alchemist Stone, and as such fulfills the same requirement as a Philosopher's Stone for performing Transmutations.
"In Time, the Arcane Corrupts All!" is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic.
Incarnation is a talented druid ability, available at level 60.
Any Hakkari Bijous that survived the Shattering are probably in this state.
__NOTOC__ Incinerator Vythe is a man'ari eredar located in Highmountain during the Legion Assaults.
Incandescent Azergem Crystalbacks are :Azerite shale spiders encountered during Island Expeditions.

Incriminating Ledger is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Indebting Word is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Incense of Infinity is sold by Au'Dara in Oribos for . You must have reached 80 Renown (Shadowlands) on at least one character to purchase it. Using it unlocks all conduits, including those for the other covenants' abilities.

The Incubus is the male variant of the Sayaad, the third demonic minion available to the warlock, summoned through the Summon Sayaad ability. The female counterpart is the Succubus. The two are functionally identical in terms of gameplay, with the only differences being cosmetic. By default, Summon Sayaad summons either an Incubus or Succubus at random, but warlocks can speak with Laphandrus Voidheart/ Kazak Darkscream to obtain a Barbed Collar of the Incubus that changes the spell to Summon Incubus, ensuring that only that gender is summoned.

Indebted Researcher's Scrounged Goods is rewarded for completing the Researchers Under Fire event at the Ruins of Drekazera in central Zaralek Cavern after achieving 12 of 12 objectives for the second time per week. The first clear instead awards the Indebted Researcher's Gift. This container contains 25x Flightstones, 30x Dragon Isles Supplies, and 50 reputation with Loamm Niffen.

Incorporeal is a level 7 affix for Mythic+. Up to two Incorporeal Beings can spawn every 45s, and they last for 20s. They cast a debuff called Destabilize with a 5s cast time, with the effect of -50% healing and damage which stacks on multiple applications. Note that this means two stacks will completely prevent players from restoring health or dealing damage (including from consumables) for the seconds until it expires, which can very likely lead to a party wipe. The being can be interrupted and crowd controlled (CCed) or controlled by effects such as Dominate Mind. Long acting crowd control such as Polymorph is preferred due to their long duration. Beings have all mob types for ability req

The Infectis Scar is a deep lake in the blighted earth of the Eastern Plaguelands. Unlike the Pestilent Scar, which was a natural gorge, the Infectis Scar on the other hand is the result of dark magic. When his runesword was broken against the shield of a dwarf captain near Corin's Crossing, the death knight Marduk Blackpool discarded the blade and kept the hilt with him. The evil blade sunk into the earth creating a chasm. When the Cataclysm occurred, the chasm filled with water, creating the lake that exists today.

Infected Nightstalker Runts have ingested bits of the Exodar's power crystals causing them to become corrupted. Exarch Menelaous at Azure Watch fears this infection will spread if left unchecked, and asks many young adventurers to purge the forests of these infected cats (see Nightstalker Clean Up, Isle 2...).
Inessera is a draenei gem vendor located on the Aldor Rise in Shattrath City. Her counterpart among the Scryers is Lisrythe Bloodwatch.

An Inert Scourgestone is a scourgestone that was purged. There is risk in dispelling the evil from a scourgestone, for it attracts the attention of undead for countless miles. High Priest Thel'danis had the power required for such an act.

Infernal Juggernauts are infernal machine creeps that can be encountered in the Outland and Black Citadel tilesets. Compared to the others they lack the cannon in the back, and shoot from a cannon underneath. The infernal juggernauts deal massive chaos damage and have the ability to summon infernals.
Infernal Sentry can be found at Shatter Scar Vale in Felwood. They can greatly detect stealth from afar, as indicated by the "Cateye" mark above their heads one can see while in stealth.
The Infinite Timebreaker is an elite infinite dragon found fighting the bronze dragonflight across time at the Bronze Dragonshrine in Dragonblight.
Infinite Eradicators are elite infinite drakes found fighting the bronze dragonflight across time in the Bronze Dragonshrine in Dragonblight.

Infinite Chrono-Magus is an infinite dragonspawn that appears during Mystery of the Infinite in the Bronze Dragonshrine to prevent the adventurer from learning the true identity of the leader of the infinite dragonflight.

Infinite Assailant is an infinite dragonspawn that appears during Mystery of the Infinite in the Bronze Dragonshrine to prevent the adventurer from learning the true identity of the leader of the infinite dragonflight.

Infinite Timerender is an elite infinite drake that will appear during Mystery of the Infinite in the Bronze Dragonshrine to prevent you from learning the true identity of the leader of the infinite dragonflight.
Infernal Power Core is dropped by Lesser Infernals in Mannoroc Coven in Desolace. It starts Jugkar's Undoing.

The Infected Granary was a building filled with plagued grain on the outskirts of an unnamed village at the King's Road. It was destroyed by Arthas Menethil and Jaina Proudmoore as soon as they found it. Three more appear later in Andorhal. They were covered in red and green flames.
Infinite Suppressors are infinite dragonflight dragonspawn guarding the Hourglass of Time in End Time.
Infinite Wardens are infinite dragonflight dragonspawn guarding the Hourglass of Time in End Time.

Inferno Blast is a Fire mage ability, available at level 24. It replaces Fire Blast, and bakes in the debuff-spreading of the old Impact (mage talent) talent. It will spread Living Bomb if chosen as the level 75 talent.
Infected Claw is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Inebriate is an ability used by Skunky Alemental during a Pet Battle.

The infested are fleshy beings that have been infested by the botani and subsequently transformed into plant-like forms. The species most frequently infested by the botani are the orcs. The early stages of mutation allow the infested humanoid to retain their former appearance, but the specimen will have significant markings of the transformation. Later stages show a significant deformation of the living organism, turning it into a plant-like, muscular zombie obedient to its Primal masters. The botani have long cultivated unique plantlife in their irrigated ponds or tree dwellings, but far more terrifying is their ability to cultivate flora within a living host. Inferno Breastplate drops from Talixae Flamewreath in the Court of Stars.
Infernal Strike is a level 10 Vengeance demon hunter ability.
Infernal Souls can be found in Shadowmoon Valley inside of the Deathforge, summoned forth by Summoner Skartax.
Infernal Chaosbringers are infernals located in the Chamber of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Infinite Loop Springs have a chance to drop from mobs on Mechagon Island during Ideas Can Come from Anywhere.

Infested Wastewander Scouts are humans located in the Chamber of the Moon in Uldum. When comforted, they'll die, as four Sandstone Hatchlings burst forth.
The Infernal Oversoul can be found in the Deathforge in Shadowmoon Valley after using the Elemental Displacer during the quest The Summoning Chamber.

Infected Corpseflies are corpseflies flying around the northeastern portion of the House of Plagues in Maldraxxus.

Inert Vessel is given by Trellain in the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores. Bathoras used his magic to transfer the essence of Duroz Scaletaker to the gem. Afterward, the gem was taken by Kolgar Flameguard.

Inert Spectral Essence can be empowered to create a Spectral Essence when used with 5x Essence of Undeath and 3x Dark Rune. Eva Sarkhoff will provide it to players who have used Krastinov's Bag of Horrors near her femur in heroic Scholomance beyond Darkmaster Gandling's room. This is one of the steps to earn the Memory of Scholomance achievement that provides access to the original Scholomance that was removed in .

Injar'i Lakebloom is a pandaren flight master located at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.

Inkgill Mere is the name of the large lake in southeastern Kun-Lai Summit and also the jinyu village on the eastern bank of the lake. Binan Village can be found on the southwest side of the lake, which feeds the Ancient Passage of the Veiled Stair. In the center of the lake is the Inkgill Ritual Island. The sha have corrupted the mere and the jinyu within it.

Injured West Plains Drifters are West Plains Drifters that have been injured in the course of the Legion invasions of Westfall. They are mainly located at Moonbrook, but a couple can also be found at the Molsen Farm. Saving them would improve the score of defense against the Legion.

Ingot is a black drakonid located in the Smoldering Perch in the Waking Shores. Outside the camp, he asks adventurers to rescue the captured red dragonflight emissary Ayasanth from his twisted Worldbreaker brothers, corrupted by Cygenoth, as well as to reduce their numbers. Gerithus then took them to the Shady Sanctuary for safekeeping. After Rymek revealed himself as a Primalist and took control of the Dream portal in Ancient Bough, the adventurer took the anchors from the sanctuary and took them to the Emerald Dream, where they placed it and summoned Ysera from Ardenweald.

There was a circle of Flying Sheep On Fire, that activated the secret level called "The Crossing", a tower-defense style map.

Inquiry of Faith is a Retribution paladin talent aimed at improving Seal of Truth's periodic damage and increasing the duration of the paladin's Inquisition (paladin ability) spell, both by large percentages.

The Inner Spire is a hall within the Firelands where Ragnaros resides. The only way to access this area is through the flamegate at the northeastern shore of the Throne of Flame, also known as Sanctum of the Prophets, on Mount Hyjal. Cenarius, Malfurion Stormrage and Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem attempt to banish Ragnaros during The Firelord. It takes their combined strength to banish him, but it was not enough and they agrees to confer with the leaders of the Horde and the Alliance for them to defeat him in his own home realm.

Inquisitors are a race of demons in service of the Burning Legion. They're horrific fel casters who see through their floating eyes and specialize in dark pacts. Of all the foul creatures that serve the Legion, the hooded inquisitors are perhaps the most mysterious, and most menacing. Allari the Souleater describes them as masters of misinformation. When killed, their body becomes one of their eyes. There are three named "high inquisitors": High Inquisitor Qormaladon of Niskara, Djin'zal of Suramar City, and High Inquisitor Raalgar in the High Inquisitor's Lair near Nath'raxas Hold.
Inquisitor's Menacing Eye is found in Small Treasure Chests on Mardum, the Shattered Abyss.

The Inscrutable Phrases are three especially complex phrases from the language of the First Ones stored in three vaults in the Endless Sands in Zereth Mortis. During Aggressive Excavation, the player needs to find the phrases and imbue them into the broken Helm of Domination. The southern phrase is in an unguarded vault. The northwestern one is in a vault sealed off by a Blocked Door which needs to be destroyed first. The northeastern one is in a vault guarded by two Fettered Wardens and under attack from a Mawsworn Inquisitor. __NOTOC__
Inner Shadow is a Discipline priest ability given by the Inner Light and Shadow talent. After activating it, it turns into Inner Light (PvP talent).

An instant is a spell or ability with a cast time of zero. In practice, instant means less than half a second but seems to depend on server response. Typically such spells can be cast on the move, which can serve as a great advantage over spells that must be cast while standing still. Instant cast spells come in many forms including DoTs such as Shadow Word: Pain and a Warlock's curses, heal-over-time spells such as Renew, and instant damage spells such as a Shaman's Earth Shock. Instant cast spells are distinct from channelled spells, which although cast instantly must then be channelled in order to take effect, and can be interrupted before their full effect is complete.

Interruption refers to slowing or stopping a target's spellcasting. There are two main types of interruption: * Interruption caused by damage (also known as pushback) * Interruption caused by specific abilities

The instant brewmaker is like a portable still, with a small heater, hollow glass tubes and coils, and beakers designed to catch the dripping end product. The entire device can fold up into a suitcase-sized container suitable for easy transport. Not surprisingly, the few pandaren technological devices that exist often focus on the creation of powerful alcoholic beverages.

Having been taught by his father and once trained in the Ring of Balance, his mastery of the very basics of combat has given him a nearly perfect fighting form. The Ironforge Guard (also known as the King's Army) are the main domestic military force of the Kingdom of Ironforge. Through this role, they act variously as city guards within the capital of Ironforge, elite bodyguards of the monarch, and a peacekeeping force within the wider Dun Morogh region. Each member of the guard is equipped with a set of plate armor, a specific attire with an iconic red color and the symbol of a hammer. Under Ironforge's government, Angus Stonehammer serves as captain of the guard. The Ironforge market is located in the seventh level of the city. It can be reached by taking the left hand passage by the Gates of Ironforge, going down four intersections, and taking the stairs to the sixth depth, turning left, then right, and going straight for four or five hundred yards, taking the next right, and going downstairs and following the line of shoppers.

Ironforge Revelers are dwarves and gnomes found in Ironforge and Moonglade during the Lunar Festival. They also appear in Ironforge and Dun Morogh during the New Year and Midsummer Fire Festival firework events.

The Ironforge Brigade Outpost was the main base of the Alliance's Ironforge Brigade in Silithus. From here, the Brigade launched its campaign in the Ahn'Qiraj War alongside forces from the nearby Cenarion Hold. The outpost itself is situated close to the silithid stronghold of Hive'Zora, which it was tasked with monitoring. The outpost remained active following the success of the war effort, and continued to be garrisoned by the Ironforge Brigade. At the time of the Argus Campaign, the outpost would be destroyed utterly when Silithus was wounded by the demon lord Sargeras.

The Ironforge Royal Treasury is the stored wealth of the Bronzebeard government of the Kingdom of Ironforge. It is kept well guarded within the city of Ironforge itself, and remains an important part of the nation's continued functionality. As its name suggests, it is principally at the disposal of the monarch of Ironforge, or under the current circumstances, the Council of Three Hammers. All ingots and pieces in the treasury are stamped with Ironforge's royal seal, making them easy to trace. Despite its importance, the treasury's security has been compromised in the past, on one occasion by the Mosshide tribe of gnolls from the Wetlands who made off with eight ingots.
